limits: Standard ZIP_DEFLATED member bytes/CRC/names/metadata verified with CPython3.11 on Windows; no claim of tested Linux extraction.
Absolute extraction length adds the destination prefix; even short member names can exceed legacy Windows MAX_PATH.
Windows and Linux differ in case sensitivity, path semantics and permission restoration; compression-only change does not alter these.
Archive byte reproducibility across zlib/runtime versions is not promised; uncompressed members and manifest are authoritative.
Higher compression may increase build CPU time; this does not change scientific evidence or member scope.
